articles.title: Geniatech Expands SOM Portfolio with NXP i.MX95‑Based SMARC and OSM Modules to Drive Edge AI Innovation
articles.description: Geniatech debuts its i.MX95 SOM series, featuring OSM and SMARC modules with multi-core ARM computing, AI acceleration, and industrial-grade reliability. Designed for smart retail, automation, and medical devices, the series delivers secure performance, energy efficiency, and long-term support with full-stack customization for next‑generation edge intelligence.

articles.title: New 'Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team' Unveiled
articles.description: Daily coverage of the pop culture products industry, including toys (action figures, models and statues), anime (anime, manga, and Japanese imports), games (collectible card and roleplaying games or ccgs and rpgs), comics (comics and graphic novels), and movie and TV (licensed) merchandise. We feature business news, and in-depth analysis for retailers, publishers, manufacturers, distributors. Trade properties we cover include Star Wars, Star Trek, X-Men, Gundam Wing, Dragonball Z, Pokemon, Akira, Lone Wolf and Cub, Magic the Gathering, Dungeons and Dragons, Mage Knight, Superman, Spider-man, JLA, Batman, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, J.R.R. Tolkien, Sailor Moon, Sandman, Harry Potter. Genres we cover include fantasy, science fiction, horror.
